scenarios.name: Fixed relation across programs
scenarios.when: Factorial and tree fold are routed through a candidate native realization of the same Sherlock reference machine.
scenarios.then: The inventory names dispatch, scalar, frame and data constraint owners, whether the realization is universal, per-program or a finite family, its common bounded StepInput/StepOutput interface and the native recursion/custom-decider adapter; complete semantic StepRecord snapshots are produced separately by host materializeStep. No VerifyProof or ledger10 prerequisite is introduced.

expected.inventory: names dispatch, scalar, frame and data constraint owners; universal vs per-program vs finite family; common StepInput/StepOutput interface; native recursion/custom-decider adapter

scenarios.judgment: Evaluator reading of the spec (UIREQ-023 requirement and scenario 1): the WHEN routes factorial and tree fold through a candidate native realization, and the THEN requires the inventory to NAME dispatch, scalar, frame and data constraint owners and the native recursion/custom-decider adapter; the requirement identifies each model transition with its circuit/host/native consumer. A hand-authored, source-only rule-to-fragment table with complete=false (fact 9/46, fold 9/57 rules with a C6 fragment), no native dispatch owner (native_selection null, status open), uncompiled/unrun fragments and an unwired recursion adapter is an honest gap report, not that realization. The check therefore verifies the inventory is truthful (exercised rules re-derived from the owner event stream, summary recomputed, every named fragment/consumer/entry present, no unclaimed C6 fragment file, table digest recomputed, one fixed table/interface across both programs) and then FAILS on the spec gates until a native realization exists. A failure message starting 'inventory dishonest' means the report lies; 'SPEC GATE' means it is honest but incomplete.
unasserted: the K-rule/fragment correspondence beyond the rule name appearing in the fragment source
fragment semantics beyond the receipted tests (nothing is proved or verified natively)
receipted tests are not re-run by the holdout: native cargo test needs the heavy lock, which the holdout must not take; receipts are verified against the factory run log and trace instead
receipts are verifiable only on a host whose qa/sherlock/traces holds the run trace (traces are gitignored); a missing trace fails as unverifiable

scenarios.evidence_rule: Fragment evidence is either 'source-only, uncompiled and unrun' (no receipt) or 'compiled-and-run' with a committed receipt crates/mori-backend/src/sherlock_machine/testdata/receipts/<name>.json: {format 'moriarty-sherlock-fragment-receipt/1', rule, file, entry, consumer, commit (40-hex), run (doctorwatson run id), trace (qa/sherlock/traces/<run>.log), trace_sha256, command (exact 'cargo test ...'), tests [{name (as cargo prints it), file, role 'positive'|'rejects-mutated-witness'}], passed, failed 0, sdk_check 'ProofPreimage::check (nonproving)'}. The receipt is cross-checked, not trusted: the qa/sherlock/runs.jsonl record for that run must show exit 0, head == commit, cmd == command and the same trace; the trace on disk must hash to trace_sha256 and show every named test 'ok' with cargo totals equal to passed and 0 failed; commit must be an ancestor of HEAD with the fragment, consumer and test files unchanged since; each test must be a #[test] fn whose body (or a local helper it calls) uses a pub fn of the fragment/consumer (including mod.rs aliases), and the rejection test must assert a rejection. cargo check or --no-run never counts. sdk_check is a nonproving preimage check, not keygen/proof/verification. Only fragments with a verified receipt clear SPEC GATE 3.

scenarios.name: Midnight stagenet end-to-end qualification
scenarios.when: Sherlock/Moriarty native target behavior is submitted for acceptance.
scenarios.then: The evidence includes actual supported source compilation, proof production and independent verification, Midnight stagenet deployment and call, and complete state/effects readback against independent expectations under pinned network/toolchain/relation identities. Unperformed stages stay not run; this scenario grants no execution authority or transfer of Preview/Fenrir evidence.
